title: incident-bot: oncall diagnostics telemetry and runbook linking enhancements
author: Noah Patel
description: Add richer telemetry and runbook linking to incident-bot on-call diagnostics. This PR instruments the diagnostics flow with structured metrics and tracing tags, surfaces SLO correlation hints produced by the slo-toolkit, and improves runbook linking for faster on-call remediation. Includes a feature flag (INCIDENT_BOT_DIAGNOSTICS_TELEMETRY) to gate rollout, unit and integration tests, docs updates, and a canary deployment strategy note. Motivation: during recent oncall incidents we observed insufficient context in diagnostics messages which increased time-to-resolution. This change aims to reduce investigation time by providing: 1) per-diagnostic run metrics (duration, cache hit, KB lookup hits), 2) context tags for inferred SLO impact, 3) clickable runbook links with intent-specific anchors, and 4) tracing spans emitted to the observability pipeline. See linked Linear tasks for rollout plan and QA checklist.

Noah Patel: Added runbook anchor sanitizer and unit tests to ensure anchor length and allowed charset. Also replaced raw runbook title tag with a stable slug.
Diego Morales: LGTM overall but requested a short note on rollout/feature flag behavior in the docs. Please include default OFF for hosted customers.
Noah Patel: Updated docs and confirmed feature flag defaults to OFF in hosted. Added config guidance for Dedicated/Private deployments.
Priya Kapoor: CI showed a flaky test on first run (timing-sensitive). Suggested replacing wall-clock sleeps with deterministic fake clock in tests.
Noah Patel: Reworked tests to use fake clock and increased timeouts for integration test harness. Reran CI and all checks passed.
release_notes: incident-bot: enhanced on-call diagnostics with telemetry, SLO correlation hints, and improved runbook linking. Feature gated behind INCIDENT_BOT_DIAGNOSTICS_TELEMETRY. Backwards-compatible. See oncall-runbooks.md for rollout steps and observability dashboard names.
